decisions.executionNote: Initialize both arms along smooth elbow-up lift. Plan watches in white, cameras in blue, cars in red; verify object geometry while approaching.
Approach the near green watch with left arm and white toy car with right, rotating grippers toward a downward grasp while maintaining elbow continuity.
Use wrist views to center watch and car, advancing and lowering conservatively with open grippers.
Lower toward watch face and car body, correcting forward alignment from wrist images before closing.
Correct wrist-image overshoot rearward, align watch face and car body between jaws, then close both grippers.
Lift straight up with both grippers commanded closed to check retention of green watch and toy car before basket transport.
Left watch is visibly retained; carry it over white basket. Right car fell back onto table; reopen and approach farther rearward for a centered retry.
Replan after continuity guard: smaller forward/lowering steps place watch inside white basket. Right approaches car lower and adjusts jaw yaw to its body.
Open left gripper to leave watch in white and withdraw. Fine-align right jaws around car, close, then begin a short retention-check lift.
Correct malformed row; no previous motion occurred. Move left toward remaining green watch while lifting the car vertically for retention check.
Center left gripper laterally and descend toward second watch. Pause right arm to distinguish a retained car from a slipping/tumbling car before transport.
Car remained suspended during pause, so carry it carefully toward red basket with gripper closed. Lower left jaws around watch and close for a retention-check lift.
Car did not follow the right arm and is now upside down on table. Lift the second green watch; move right to the metal watch for a centered grasp.
Second green watch follows left gripper; carry at moderate height into white basket. Center right jaws over the metal watch, lower and close.
Left contacted the basket rim and lost the second watch; retreat upward and restore orientation. Lift metal watch with right and check retention before staging near center.
Use a small orientation-first bridge from the observed contact-deflected left pose, then withdraw. Keep right watch closed during its vertical retention-check lift.
Both loose watches remain on table. Reapproach their updated positions with open grippers, using a more rearward right grasp through the band sides.
Close on the centered green watch without lowering into basket rim. Adjust metal watch alignment forward and right, close on its band, then lift both slightly to verify retention.
Both watches now move with the jaws. Lift and tilt left wrist forward to clear white basket rim before release. Carry metal watch toward a central handoff staging area without crossing arms.
Release the second green watch over white basket and withdraw left. Lower retained metal watch onto a central table staging spot for left-arm pickup.
Set the metal watch on the central table and clear right arm laterally. Bring left toward the staging area while keeping separation; two green watches are visible in white basket.
Approach staged metal watch from left side of shared center with slight wrist tilt. Right reapproaches the upside-down car at its updated table position.
Fine-center both objects using wrist images. Lower around metal band and upside-down car sides, then close without lateral motion.
Lift both closed grippers to test retention. Begin a gentle leftward, forward-tilting retreat with the metal watch; do not transport the car until it visibly follows.
Both objects slipped. Reopen and approach their new positions; return left wrist to vertical and rotate right jaws across the car's shorter dimension for a deeper side grasp.
Use wrist centering to lower more deeply onto metal band and car sidewalls. Close only after the descent, avoiding lateral motion during closure.
Contact shifted both objects away from jaw centers. Reopen, back left toward the metal ring and shift right toward car center while lifting off contact; inspect before closing again.
Objects are now between open jaw pads at safe height. Apply small centering corrections, close steadily, and lift only 3 cm to verify retention.
Car now appears supported between the right pads; lift and carry gradually toward red with forward tilt. Metal watch escaped left; reopen and approach its solid face rather than ring center.
Car is visibly retained during transport; move over red basket at rim-clearing height. Recenter left on metal watch band and test a gentle closure and short lift.
Release car into red and retract right toward the central camera. Lift the metal watch by its solid face and carry left with forward tilt to clear the white basket.
Replan from guard interruption with smaller right-arm wrist rotation and translation. Continue carrying retained metal watch toward white basket, maintaining clearance.
Place metal watch fully over white basket and open, then withdraw. Orient right wrist downward while approaching the remaining right-side camera for blue basket.
Three watches are visible inside white basket. Approach gold vehicle with left. Lift right off camera contact and rotate to pinch its shorter dimension before descending again.
Servo open jaws toward object centers using wrist views: left forward to gold tank, right inward along camera length. Descend conservatively and inspect before closing.
Center gold tank and camera between pads, close without dragging, and lift 3.5 cm to check whether each object follows.
Right camera appears between pads; lift and tilt forward to clear basket rim. Left missed the tank; reopen and move rearward and inward to its body center before closing again.
Camera visibly follows right gripper; bring it inside blue basket. Lift tank cautiously and start rearward staging motion only after clearance.
Release the retained camera in blue and clear right arm. Tank was not retained; prioritize the two remaining cameras, approaching the nearer one with left jaws across its narrow dimension.
Replan the right retreat with smaller increments after continuity rejection. Continue left approach to the nearer camera and inspect jaw alignment before closing.
Center the nearer camera between left pads, close and lift briefly to verify retention. Move right clear of the shared middle basket.
Camera is visibly supported between left pads after lift. Carry it toward blue with a forward tilt for rim clearance. Reorient the idle right wrist gradually in its own workspace.
Move the held camera away from the blue basket's near-left rim, open to release, then withdraw. Finish the right wrist's gradual return to a downward orientation.
Two cameras are visible in blue. Begin a small retreat from the guarded near-extension pose, then move left toward the final camera while returning the wrist downward.
Approach the final left-side camera with open jaws, rotating across its short dimension. Keep the right arm clear for the later vehicle transfer.
Wrist view places the final camera outside the left jaw center. Correct laterally and slightly rearward while lowering slowly; keep jaws open until centered.
Camera shifted and rolled face-up. Lift clear before recentering over its new position, with jaws across the narrow dimension to avoid pushing it again.
Make a small final correction over the face-up camera, descend to side-grasp height, then close while stationary. Right stays clear.
Lift the camera vertically with closed jaws to verify retention, then begin a gentle inward transport and forward tilt toward blue basket.
The camera stayed on the table, so reopen and return for a lower side grasp. Recenter from both head and wrist geometry instead of assuming closure retained it.
Move the face-up camera into the jaw contact region while descending to a lower side-grasp height; close stationary and inspect before lifting.
Lift the camera from this lower grasp with closure maintained, then start a small inward motion to test whether it follows before committing to basket transport.
Camera again stayed on table. Reopen and approach its center rather than the far edge; restore downward wrist and inspect at low height before closure.
Fine-center the camera body between jaw pads, descend only slightly, close gradually, and lift 3 cm to verify a centered side grasp.
Camera is now centered between pads after the short lift. Carry inward toward blue while raising and tilting forward, keeping the grip closed and right arm clear.
Final camera visibly follows the left jaws. Move it over blue basket with forward tilt and rim clearance, retaining closure until its release position is confirmed.
Release the final camera inside blue, then retreat in small increments from the extended pose. Begin reorienting left for the gold vehicle, the remaining unsorted object.
Three cameras are visible in blue. Move left above the gold vehicle and restore a downward, widthwise grasp orientation, keeping the right arm clear.
Center left gripper over the tank body using the wrist view, approach slowly near the white basket rim, and inspect at grasp height before closing.
The open gripper contacted the white basket rim. Retreat the wrist and tilt the fingers forward so the tank can be approached from the near side without disturbing sorted watches.
Tank body is centered between the open pads with the wrist clear of the basket. Lower carefully for a side grasp and close while stationary.
Lift the centered gold vehicle vertically and retreat from the white basket, retaining closure. Verify that it follows before moving to the shared staging area.
Tank stayed on the table. Reopen and approach lower on the tank's sidewalls rather than its upper turret, retaining the forward wrist tilt for basket clearance.
Make a small centering correction at the lower tank-sidewall height, close gradually, and lift only 18 mm to test retention before transport.
Lift and retreat from the basket with the lower sidewall grasp, maintaining orientation and closure; use the small inward shift to verify whether the gold vehicle follows.
Gold vehicle visibly follows the left jaws. Carry it to the shared central staging area while maintaining grip and orientation; right waits clear for the transfer.
Lower the retained gold vehicle onto the central table, release it, and clear left arm before the right approaches. Vehicle has rotated in the grasp, so inspect its settled orientation.
Gold vehicle has settled on the shared center table. Clear left back toward its origin while right approaches from its own side with open jaws for the final transfer.
Return left close to origin with continuous elbow-up motion. Center right over the staged gold vehicle, aligning the jaws across its rotated narrow dimension before closure.
Finish the left return to origin. Adjust right fingertips toward the tank with a slight inward tilt while keeping its EE on the right side; lower and close on the body.
Keep left at origin. Lift the gold vehicle with right closure maintained, then test a small rightward transport before committing to the red basket.
Gold vehicle stayed on the table. Reopen and approach its updated body center farther rearward, accounting for the tilted fingertip offset; inspect before closing.
Center the tank's body between right pads and descend to sidewall height, then close while stationary. Left remains at origin.
Lift the gold vehicle with closed right jaws, then test a short rightward translation to confirm retention before carrying toward red.
The tank rolled out of the right grasp. Reopen and withdraw slightly while it settles, restoring a vertical approach for a centered retry.
Gold vehicle settled back in the left workspace. Clear the right arm and reengage left along the elbow-up path to restage the vehicle where right can grasp vertically.
Approach the gold vehicle from the left at clearance height, rotating smoothly toward a downward grasp. Right remains separated and stationary.
